title: Task
description: The typed contract a Planner must produce. Fuzzy goals go in; a strictly validated object comes out. Every downstream component knows exactly what it is receiving, which is what stops drift.

schema_version.description: Bump only with a migration plan for stored streams.

task_type.description: Selects the worker and the default verifier family.

objective.description: What done looks like, in one sentence.

files.description: Files the worker may touch. Empty means unrestricted within the sandbox workspace.

budget_usd.description: Hard ceiling. The scheduler halts the task on breach; it is not advisory.

verifier.description: Registered verifier name, e.g. python_test_runner. There is no universal 'is this good?' function — each domain plugs in its own objective check.
